name: Cartitas draft generator
description: Daily agent writes the same new cards in en, es, and de, then updates one open PR.

prompts.prompt:
Follow .cursor/automation-generate-draft.md exactly.

CRITICAL: Every run MUST create the SAME card set in ALL THREE languages (en, es, de) before committing. If validate_trilingual.py fails, add missing language files — do not commit.

Each run: pick ONE topic + subtopic + age band, write three files with identical filenames:
- draft/en/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md
- draft/es/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md
- draft/de/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md

1. Read languages.yaml, publish.yaml, templates/card-style.md, templates/topic-seeds/{topic}.md.
2. Write English first, then Spanish and German (same facts).
3. Run: python3 scripts/validate.py && python3 scripts/validate_trilingual.py
4. Do NOT push to main. Do NOT use gh pr create on cursor/* branches.
5. Run ONLY: python3 scripts/draft_pr.py --message "draft({topic}/{subtopic}): add {n} cards x3 langs ({age_band})" --pr-note "Langs: en, es, de | Topic: {topic} | Subtopic: {subtopic}"
6. Confirm: gh pr list --head automation/draft-cards --state open
